sentences.text: The CCC examined whether publicising corruption allegations served the public interest and whether restrictions were needed.
sentences.support: examine whether it is in the public interest to publicise allegations of corrupt conduct

sentences.text: It considered public submissions, a public forum, legislation, earlier reports and its own operational information.
sentences.support: reviewed relevant legislation, previous reports and relevant existing CCC data

sentences.text: The CCC favoured retaining the law except for publicity about councillors and candidates during local government elections.
sentences.support: with one exception, there should be no change to the law.

sentences.text: Its recommendation asked the government to consider an offence for publicising allegations, or the fact of a CCC complaint, about councillors and candidates during local elections without first notifying the CCC and allowing at least three months for assessment.
sentences.support: without first notifying the CCC and allowing the CCC at least three months to determine whether the allegations have merit.

findings.quote: On balance, the CCC is of the view that, with one exception, there should be no change to the law.
